ont.description: ONT reads (BAM, CRAM or FASTQ.GZ; BAM/CRAM are converted to FASTQ): comma-separated paths, glob patterns or URLs

illumina.description: Illumina reads (FASTQ.GZ): comma-separated paths, glob patterns or URLs. Paired-end files are recognized when ending with regex pattern '_(R?[12])(_[0-9][0-9][0-9])?.(fq|fastq).gz$'
